pagedata.pyBrowseSQL: SELECT c.branchname AS CABANG, c.sobname AS "Sources", CASE WHEN c.grouppanel = '002' THEN 'PA' WHEN c.grouppanel = '003' THEN 'Aneka' WHEN c.grouppanel = '004' THEN 'Marine Cargo' WHEN c.grouppanel = '005' THEN 'Travel' WHEN c.grouppanel = '006' THEN 'Fire' ELSE c.grouppanel END AS "BusinessName", ( SELECT t.businessname FROM pooldata.t_general t WHERE t.nopolis = c.nopolis ORDER BY TO_NUMBER (t.prodke) DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY ) AS "District", c.nopolis AS "PolicyNo", ( SELECT t.theinsured FROM pooldata.t_general t WHERE t.nopolis = c.nopolis ORDER BY TO_NUMBER (t.prodke) DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY ) AS "InsuredName", c.claimno AS "ClaimNo", c.registerdate AS "RegisterDate", c.dateofloss AS "DateOfLoss", c.remarkrecomendation AS "RemarkRecommendation", (NVL(E.RESERVES2, 0)) AS "ReserveClaimFull", (NVL(E.RESERVES, 0) * (C.SHAREASM / 100)) AS "ReserveClaimASM", (NVL(E.RESERVES, 0) * ((100 - C.SHAREASM) / 100)) AS "Coins", (NVL(E.RESERVES, 0) * (C.SHAREASM / 100) * NVL(TL.CLAIM_OR, 0)) AS "OR", (NVL(E.RESERVES, 0) * (C.SHAREASM / 100) * NVL(TL.CLAIM_FAC_OUT, 0)) AS "FACOUT", (NVL(E.RESERVES, 0) * (C.SHAREASM / 100) * NVL(TL.CLAIM_FACOB, 0)) AS "FACOB", (NVL(E.RESERVES, 0) * (C.SHAREASM / 100) * NVL(TL.CLAIM_QS, 0)) AS "QS", (NVL(E.RESERVES, 0) * (C.SHAREASM / 100) * NVL(TL.CLAIM_FSPL, 0)) AS "FSPL", (NVL(E.RESERVES, 0) * (C.SHAREASM / 100) * NVL(TL.CLAIM_SSPL, 0)) AS "SSPL", (NVL(E.RESERVES, 0) * (C.SHAREASM / 100) * NVL(TL.CLAIM_ER1, 0)) AS "ER1", (NVL(E.RESERVES, 0) * (C.SHAREASM / 100) * NVL(TL.CLAIM_ER2, 0)) AS "ER2", (NVL(E.RESERVES, 0) * (C.SHAREASM / 100) * NVL(TL.CLAIM_BPPDAN, 0)) AS "BPPDAN", (NVL(E.RESERVES, 0) * (C.SHAREASM / 100) * NVL(TL.CLAIM_PSRQS, 0)) AS "PSRQS", (NVL(E.RESERVES, 0) * (C.SHAREASM / 100) * NVL(TL.CLAIM_PSRSPL, 0)) AS "PSRSPL", (NVL(E.RESERVES, 0) * (C.SHAREASM / 100) * NVL(TL.CLAIM_ORS, 0)) AS "ORS", (NVL(E.RESERVES, 0) * (C.SHAREASM / 100) * NVL(TL.CLAIM_XL, 0)) AS "XL", (NVL(E.RESERVES, 0) * (C.SHAREASM / 100) * NVL(TL.CLAIM_PSROR, 0)) AS "PSROR", (NVL(E.RESERVES, 0) * (C.SHAREASM / 100) * NVL(TL.CLAIM_QSOR, 0)) AS "QSOR", (NVL(E.RESERVES, 0) * (C.SHAREASM / 100) * NVL(TL.CLAIM_PSS, 0)) AS "PSS", (NVL(E.RESERVES, 0) * (C.SHAREASM / 100) * NVL(TL.CLAIM_PRGBI, 0)) AS "PRGBI", (NVL(E.RESERVES, 0) * (C.SHAREASM / 100) * NVL(TL.CLAIM_PFRA, 0)) AS "PFRA", (NVL(E.RESERVES, 0) * (C.SHAREASM / 100) * NVL(TL.CLAIM_FSPLNSRI, 0)) AS "FSPLNSRI", (NVL(E.RESERVES, 0) * (C.SHAREASM / 100) * NVL(TL.CLAIM_PSPLNSRI, 0)) AS "PSPLNSRI", (NVL(E.RESERVES, 0) * (C.SHAREASM / 100) * NVL(TL.CLAIM_FSPLNSOR, 0)) AS "FSPLNSOR", (NVL(E.RESERVES, 0) * (C.SHAREASM / 100) * NVL(TL.CLAIM_PSPLNSOR, 0)) AS "PSPLNSOR", (NVL(E.RESERVES, 0) * (C.SHAREASM / 100) * NVL(TL.CLAIM_FACOBSRB, 0)) AS "FACOBSRB", (NVL(E.RESERVES, 0) * (C.SHAREASM / 100) * NVL(TL.CLAIM_FACOBINDT, 0)) AS "FACOBINDT", p.tgl_input AS "TanggalTerlambat", m1.sts_progress1 AS "StatusProgress1", m2.sts_progress2 AS "StatusProgress2", c.picteknik AS "PICRekanan", p.keterangan AS "Keterangan", TRUNC(SYSDATE) - TRUNC(c.registerdate) AS "AgingKlaim", c.branchcode, s.surveyor_name AS "NamaSurveyor", col.causeofloss AS "CauseOfLoss", ( SELECT NVL( LISTAGG(m.name, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY t.idx_dominanfactor), '-' ) FROM POOLDATA.T_CLAIM_DOMINANFACTOR t JOIN POOLDATA.M_DOMINAN_FACTOR m ON m.id = t.id_dominanfactor WHERE t.claimid = c.claimid ) AS "DominanName", c.kronologi AS "Kronologis" FROM pooldata.t_claim_pnc c JOIN datapega.pc_asm_fw_gcnmfw_work w ON c.claimid = w.pzinskey AND w.pystatuswork NOT IN ('Resolved-Rejected', 'Resolved-Completed') AND w.pxobjclass = 'ASM-FW-GCNMFW-Work-PNC' LEFT JOIN ( SELECT * FROM ( SELECT p.pnccaseid, p.tgl_input, p.status_progress1, p.status_progress2, p.keterangan, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY p.pnccaseid ORDER BY p.tgl_input DESC ) rn FROM POOLDATA.GCNM_PROGRESS_CLAIM p WHERE p.status_progress1 IS NOT NULL ) WHERE rn = 1 ) p ON p.pnccaseid = c.claimno LEFT JOIN ( SELECT id_progress, MAX(sts_progress1) AS sts_progress1 FROM POOLDATA.GCNM_MST_PROGRESS GROUP BY id_progress ) m1 ON m1.id_progress = p.status_progress1 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT id_mst, MAX(sts_progress2) AS sts_progress2 FROM POOLDATA.GCNM_MST_PROGRESS GROUP BY id_mst ) m2 ON m2.id_mst = p.status_progress2 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT claimid, SUM(estimationvalue * NVL(kursvalue, 1)) AS RESERVES, SUM(estimationvalue) AS RESERVES2 FROM pooldata.T_CLAIM_ESTIMASI GROUP BY claimid ) E ON e.claimid = c.claimid LEFT JOIN ( SELECT pnccaseid, MAX(surveyor_name) AS surveyor_name FROM POOLDATA.T_SURVEYORLIST WHERE SURVEYTYPE = '2' GROUP BY pnccaseid ) s ON s.pnccaseid = c.claimid LEFT JOIN ( SELECT claimid, MAX(causeofloss) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY createdatetime) AS causeofloss FROM POOLDATA.T_CLAIM_OBJECTCOVERAGE GROUP BY claimid ) col ON col.claimid = c.claimid LEFT JOIN ( SELECT * FROM ( SELECT tr.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY tr.no_klaim ORDER BY tr.no_spk DESC ) rn FROM treaty_loss@asmd.sinarmas.co.id tr WHERE tr.no_klaim LIKE 'PNC-%' ) WHERE rn = 1 ) tl ON tl.no_klaim = c.claimno WHERE c.registerdate IS NOT NULL AND c.branchcode = {OperatorID.pyTelephone} ORDER BY "AgingKlaim" DESC
